name: Frequency 7 Code
definition: Specifies the regularity of an event.

YEAR.name: Annual
YEAR.definition: Event takes place every year or once a year.

MNTH.name: Monthly
MNTH.definition: Event takes place every month or once a month.

QURT.name: Quarterly
QURT.definition: Event takes place every three months or four times a year.

MIAN.name: Semi Annual
MIAN.definition: Event takes place every six months or two times a year.

TEND.name: Ten Days
TEND.definition: Event takes place every ten business days.

MOVE.name: Triggered By Movement
MOVE.definition: Event takes place at the end of the day if there was a movement on the account, otherwise nothing is sent that day.

WEEK.name: Weekly
WEEK.definition: Event takes place once a week.

INDA.name: Intra Day
INDA.definition: Event takes place several times a day.
